intro.fr: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub Str8UpWHITE64/Librarian-AP, qui héberge l'APWorld de Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library.
text.en: The GitHub repository Str8UpWHITE64/Librarian-AP, home of the Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la version 3.0.1, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (28 versions publiées).
text.en: Version 3.0.1 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (28 versions released).

text.fr: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
